KellyOCG is recruiting for an Infrastructure Engineer to provide onsite deskside IT support at the Waterloo location. The role handles routine user support, equipment and asset records, ticket resolution, and escalation of issues beyond established procedures.
Consulting
No H1B
Hiring Manager
Cressa Mast
Responsibilities
Perform and monitor routine IT support processes, such as imaging computers, replacing printer toner, disposing of outdated assets, and resolving tickets from ServiceNow queues
Follow knowledge base articles and unit-specific procedures to resolve user issues
Update asset records in Asset Center and maintain process logs, contact lists, incident reports, inventory records, and other documentation
Communicate effectively by email and maintain basic documents and records
Identify process or operational problems, resolve issues using established procedures, and escalate issues beyond the role’s scope
Maintain equipment, supplies, and data, including scheduling routine maintenance, ordering supplies, and monitoring inventory
Apply basic technical knowledge to troubleshoot equipment, such as printers, and resolve end-user tickets
Qualification
Computer Security
Networking Fundamentals
Required
Knowledge of computing and networking fundamentals
Ability to use standard desktop applications, including Microsoft Office, as well as intranet and internet resources
Familiarity with computer security policies and general security concepts
High school diploma or equivalent
Preferred
At least one year of IT experience
Recent college graduates will also be considered
An IT-related degree or equivalent experience is preferred
